package clientmembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/clientmembers/gen/jsonrpc/members/client"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/jsonrpc"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type receivingStream interface {
	Recv() (string, error)
	Close() error
}

func TestSSEClientRoles(t *testing.T) {
	peer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var request jsonrpc.RawRequest
		if err := json.UnmarshalRead(r.Body, &request); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		var payload string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(request.Params, &payload); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": request.ID, "result": request.Method + ":" + payload})
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "event: response\ndata: %s\n\n", data); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}))
	defer peer.Close()
	u, err := url.Parse(peer.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, peer.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	for _, test := range []struct {
		method   string
		endpoint loom.Endpoint
	}{
		{"watch", c.Watch()},
		{"watchDoer", c.WatchDoer()},
		{"buildWatchRequest", c.BuildWatchRequest()},
	} {
		value, err := test.endpoint(context.Background(), "payload")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		stream := value.(receivingStream)
		got, err := stream.Recv()
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if got != test.method+":payload" {
			t.Errorf("method %s result %v", test.method, got)
		}
		if err := stream.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}
}
